items.title: TSA Launches Military 'Honor Lanes' - Will They Cause Longer Lines For Regular Flyers?
items.summary: The US Transportation Security Administration (TSA) has rolled out a new perk for American military veterans and current service members, as well as their families, at more than 30 airports across the US. This comes in the form of a dedicated 'Honor Lane' at security checkpoints at participating facilities, with military flyers at airports without these lanes also able to be fast-tracked upon showing their ID.
